classification.rationale: Valve heads, coupling heads and faucet spare parts are parts of taps and valves under 8481.90. F83298 (in force) classifies a hand-operated faucet in 8481.80.50, supporting heading 8481 and the hand-operated faucet family. The material split (copper, iron or steel, other) is assumed.
